LESSON: READING FOR UNDERSTANDING

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: MANDARIN
Strand: Reading 2.1 Reading Aloud (2 lessons) • Pronunciation (tones) By the end of the 
Topic 2.3: Reading for Understanding

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Reading for Understanding. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: How can understanding be enhanced in reading texts?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Reading for Understanding
2. Give Kenyan examples for Reading for Understanding
3. Practise Reading for Understanding at school and at home

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: READING FOR UNDERSTANDING
This lesson teaches Reading for Understanding for Grade 7 MANDARIN.

STUDY STEPS
1. Explain the main ideas in Reading for Understanding
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. Give Kenyan examples for Reading for Understanding
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
3. Practise Reading for Understanding at school and at home
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Reading for Understanding using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Reading for Understanding above.
2. Explain Reading for Understanding to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Reading for Understanding.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Reading for Understanding with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Reading for Understanding important for a Grade 7 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How can understanding be enhanced in reading texts?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Explain the main ideas in Reading for Understanding
2. Give Kenyan examples for Reading for Understanding
3. Practise Reading for Understanding at school and at home

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
